note: Rewritten from Krishna 1962; original in English; the measurements are taken from table 2 (a single holotype, no range) and are transcribed verbatim.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is closest to C. parvinotus, differing in the larger head and pronotum, the more projecting anterior dorsal lobes of the frons, and the deeper notch between the lobes. C. nigriceps has the anterior part of the head less steep in side view, the anterior dorsal lobes of the frons not projecting, the notch between the lobes narrower and shallower, and the outer basal margin of the mandibles wavy; C. nearcticus has a shorter and narrower head and pronotum, a wider and shallower notch between the frontal lobes, and a less deeply notched posterior margin of the pronotum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish brown, dark reddish brown to almost black anteriorly; mandibles reddish brown, paler than the posterior part of the head; pronotum brown; antennae yellowish brown; forelegs brown with yellow, mid and hind legs pale yellow; abdominal sternites white with yellow. Head and pronotum with a few short setae. Head slightly longer than wide; sides converging anteriorly; frons bilobed, the surface of the lobes rough, a deep V-shaped notch between the lobes; in side view the top of the frons vertical, the middle inclined at an angle, the dorsum concave; in dorsal view the middle of the frontal slope concave; an angular projection of the gena between the base of the mandibles and below the antennal socket; posterior margin weakly concave. Mandibles short, the outer margin nearly straight; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, teeth 2 and 3 very weak, the cutting edge concave between teeth 2 and 3; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the tip of the first marginal tooth 0.19 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Shape of the postmentum as figured, contraction index 0.86. Antennae 11-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2 or segment 4. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin broadly concave, posterior margin deeply notched, posterior lateral margins rounded. Measurements (mm, holotype): head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.58; head width 1.35; head height 1.16; left mandible length 0.49; postmentum maximum width 0.45; postmentum minimum width 0.39; postmentum length 0.77; pronotum median length 0.41; pronotum maximum length 0.71; pronotum width 1.28; hind tibia length 0.71.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate unknown. Type locality: Ilha Grande, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (about 22°59′—23°7′ S, 44°7′—44°26′ W), collected by H. Muth and H. Sick on 1944-06-11 (no. 14); the holotype is 1 soldier, with nymphs.
